To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the breadth of competition among sellers improves the performance in the short- and the long-term, and the depth of competition has a positive effect in the short-term, but a negative effect in the long-term, for the performance of electronic platforms.

the breadth of competition among sellers improves the performance in both the short and the long term, and that the depth of competition has a positive effect in the short term but a negative effect in the long term.

the breadth of competition among sellers increases the performance of the platform company, the depth of competition has a positive effect in the short run and a negative effect in the long run, the advertising tactics that attract the new customers contribute more to the breadth of competition, and the subsidies that attract the new sellers decrease the competition more than those attract the old sellers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the management of the seller competition on electronic platforms, and the performance implications of different customer relationship marketing tactics.
the effects of seller competition on platform performance and the underlying mechanisms of the impact of customer marketing strategies on seller competition.
the management of competition between sellers and its performance effects on business-to-business electronic platform companies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

platform companies should implement effective control over the breadth and depth competition of sellers, and that the tactics of exploiting and exploring two-sided customers should be used to achieve the best results.
a platform company can increase the breadth of competition amongst its sellers by attracting new buyers and decrease the depth of competition by subsidizing new sellers.
platform companies can increase their performance by implementing the right marketing tactics to attract new customers, and by using subsidies to control the depth of competition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the platform company can use the two-sided marketing tactics to influence the competition among sellers, and thus improve the performance of the platform.
we investigated the underlying mechanisms by which the two-sided marketing tactics of platform companies influence the structure of the seller competition and its performance implications.
platform companies should focus on attracting new customers and controlling new sellers in order to improve platform performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
platform companies should implement effective control over the competition between sellers in order to balance the interests between themselves and their sellers.
platform companies need to pay attention to the effects of different customer relationship tactics and the competitive structures between sellers in the short and long run.
platform companies should adopt a dynamic and long-term view when managing the competition between sellers.
